title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary:
**BITCOIN MORNING BRIEF — July 3rd**

Bitcoin holding steady at 61,649, up a modest 0.8 overnight. Network health remains robust—hashrate sitting at 871 exahashes, hitting near-cycle highs. That's builders staying committed despite the noise.

Here's what matters: extreme fear is back. Greed index bottomed at 21. That's capitulation territory, and historically, these are the moments before snapback rallies. Mempool's clean too—99,448 transactions, fees at 4 sat/vB. No congestion. No panic sellin
